Introduction

CAMO, born Park Chae‑ryeong, is a bilingual South Korean rapper, singer, and songwriter under 502. Born in Hong Kong, she made her debut in 2020 with the EP Ice and quickly made her breakout with the summer anthem "Life Is Wet" featuring JMIN. CAMO expanded her sound with tracks like “Freak Like Me” and “Mapsi”, building a unique musical identity built around trap, R&B, and traditional Asian influences. This was followed by her debut album Pressure Makes Diamonds in 2023.

In October 2024, she dropped the mixtape Yours Truly, venturing into pop & drum & bass influences. The title track "K‑PACK" features cameo from model & actress Hong Jin‑kyung in a cinematic video set at a kimchi factory.

Her stage name CAMO is an acronym for “Cash Money”. The name was given to her during her college years by a friend, and she decided to keep it when she started pursuing music professionally.
